stage7.event: Initial SDK test compile encountered DOM typing assumptions
stage7.handling: Adjusted the bounded SDK type/test boundary and reran to green; public contract unchanged.

stage7.event: A broad read-only plan search exceeded its 30-second bound
stage7.handling: Interrupted it and used the exact run path; no repository mutation.

stage7.event: Root bare import lacked the package-lock-declared SDK workspace link
stage7.handling: Used a validated ignored temporary link for the locked smoke and removed/restored it afterward.

stage7.event: Offline consumer npm install returned ENOTCACHED for one Runtime dependency
stage7.handling: Replaced it with an actual extracted published-tarball JS/TypeScript consumer; no network or package-lock change.

stage7.event: One broad rm cleanup command was rejected before execution by policy
stage7.handling: Validated ownership and cleaned through the bounded Node filesystem API.

stage7.event: First sparse-array validator replay used stale Contracts dist and reported 7 failures
stage7.handling: Built Contracts first, then the dense 93/93 systematic cases passed without a source correction.

stage7.event: One full G07 run had four transient unrelated CLI timeouts
stage7.handling: The four affected files/eight tests passed in isolation, then the exact complete npm run check exited 0.

stage7.event: T11/T12 review blockers across three rounds
stage7.handling: Targeted T13 remediation and complete affected/full/review replay; ultimate dual PASS on one frozen snapshot.

stage7.event: The Stage 7 pre-transition validator rejected two administrative drafts
stage7.handling: Added execution_mode, corrected it to goal while retaining subagent-only ownership, then reran the exact validator before transition.

stage8Repair.event: Two whole-repository architecture tests exceeded Vitest's 5-second default in a combined focused invocation
stage8Repair.handling: Applied an explicit 20-second per-test bound and replayed the exact combined focused command before recapture.

stage8Repair.event: The Stage 8 G02 root bare-import smoke again found the package-lock-declared SDK workspace link absent
stage8Repair.handling: Used a validated ignored temporary link for the locked smoke, removed it immediately, and replayed the complete exact G02 command with the same bounded link lifecycle.

stage8Repair.event: The first identity-hardening replay redundantly walked the full closure twice and exceeded Vitest's 5-second current-snapshot test default
stage8Repair.handling: Removed the redundant second walk after the component and overall manifest checks, applied an explicit 20-second test bound, and replayed the exact combined suite.
